title: tc-column-mapper
description:
Match a file's columns to your fields: a model's suggestion per column with its confidence in words, a select of
fields (or Don't import) per column, required fields left out and duplicates in words, and Accept all suggestions.

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – the file, or what the rows become

fields.description: The fields the rows are imported into

suggestions.description: The model's suggestion per column, with how sure it is

mapping.description: The value: column id → field id, null for "Don't import". Columns left out use their suggestion. Changed unless a tc-mapping-change listener calls preventDefault()

hideContinue.description: Hides Continue, for a page with its own next step

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultColumnMapperLabels

name.description: The header as written in the file

samples.description: A few values from the column, to recognise it by

type.description: What the field holds, shown beside its name: "text", "number", "date", "email" …

required.description: Rows can't be imported unless a column goes to it

ColumnMapperField.description: A field the rows will be imported into

field.description: The field it goes to, or null for "Don't import"

confidence.description: How sure the model is, 0 to 1

ColumnMapperSuggestion.description: The model's suggestion for one column
